description.value: Bean Around The World Coffees is a BC-based independent coffee chain with over 35 years of history, roasting its own beans from a North Vancouver roastery. The Ambleside location sits on Marine Drive in West Vancouver, making it a natural stop for cyclists riding the coastal route between West Vancouver and North Vancouver. The brand sells coffee drinks, retail beans, brewing gear, and apparel alongside its in-store café experience.

address.value: 1522 Marine Drive, West Vancouver, BC V7V 1H8

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands at 7m; stands (2 spaces) at 42m; stands (4 spaces) at 55m; stands (4 spaces) at 93m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating Bean Around The World Coffees location at 1522 Marine Drive, West Vancouver, BC with listed hours, corroborating the OSM street address. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all amenity fields remain null. A notable discrepancy: OSM places this record in the 'North Vancouver' community, but the website clearly states the store is in West Vancouver (Ambleside); separately, the website footer address (1462 Columbia Street, North Vancouver) is the roastery HQ, not this store.
concerns: OSM community field lists this as 'North Vancouver' but the store address is West Vancouver (Ambleside); postal code V7V 1H8 also corresponds to West Vancouver. OSM community metadata should be corrected.
Website footer and contact page show '1462 Columbia Street, North Vancouver, BC V7J 1A2' — this is the roastery headquarters, not this store location.

Store-specific phone (+1 604 925 9600 from OSM) is not shown on the store's website page; the website lists only a general support line (1-888-294-1111), so the OSM phone number cannot be confirmed or denied.
